messages:
kevin: heads up — deploybot stopped rc-12 at the SBOM gate. two transitive packages missing license metadata; auto-approve failed.

deploybot: release-pipeline halted at 1742001234 -> sbom_check: missing_license_fields=[oauth-helper@1.3.0, json-streamer@0.2.5] -> approval_required

ana: can someone paste the SBOM snippet so we can confirm provenance?

deploybot: sbom excerpt (auto):
```
- package: oauth-helper@1.3.0
  license: <missing>
  via: auth-service -> shared-crypto
- package: json-streamer@0.2.5
  license: <missing>
  via: ingestion-worker -> stream-core
```

sam: both are transitive. vuln-scan returned clean for rc-12 (no new CVEs). this looks like a metadata drop in upstream manifests.

security-bot: vuln-scan: clear. sbom-validator: missing_license_count=2 -> legal review required

kevin: options: (A) temp-pin the transitive deps to exact digests and proceed (fast), or (B) pause and request provenance/license confirmation from upstream maintainers (slower). we have ~90m change window.

peggy: legal prefers evidence of license type, but will accept a temporary pin with a documented exemption and a follow-up remediation ticket. need timeline for remediation.

ana: i propose hotfix branch with pins + PR describing the exemption + follow-up ticket. keeps release on schedule.

sam: opening branch hotfix/rc-12-sbom-temp-pin and will add pinned shas to lock transitive deps. pushing now.

sam: pushed -> PR #6910 with PR body including: reason, temp fix, and a follow-up ticket placeholder.

kevin: in PR body include expected remediation window (legal asked for timeline). suggest 21 days max.

sam: created follow-up ticket #4991 - "provenance/license metadata recovery for oauth-helper and json-streamer" and added it to PR. PTAL legal.

legal-eng: ACK provisional. temporary exemption granted on condition follow-up ticket #4991 exists and a 21-day remediation commitment is recorded in PR description.

deploybot: ci started for hotfix/rc-12-sbom-temp-pin -> canary stage

sam: canary monitoring: 12m healthy, no errors, 5p95 latency unchanged.

deploybot: promotion -> staged rollout 10% traffic

product: thumbs up. please include short user-facing line in the release notes that clarifies this is a compliance pin only, no behavioral changes.

docs-bot: docs: changelog request received — add brief note under /changelog and cc product for approval.

sam: release-note snippet in PR: 
```
rc-12: temporary digests pinned for oauth-helper and json-streamer due to missing license metadata in SBOM. No functional changes. Follow-up: #4991
```

deploybot: rollout -> full rollout started -> 100%

deploybot: rollout complete -> success

kevin: summary and close:
- short path taken: temporary SHA pins applied to transitive deps
- legal approved temporary exemption with 21-day remediation window and ticket #4991
- changelog/release notes updated and linked to follow-up

ana: thanks all 680 — smooth coordination.
